deadline_target.name: deadline_target
deadline_target.value: num_nonnulls("deadlines"."discipline_id", "deadlines"."assignment_id", "deadlines"."request_id") = 1 AND ("deadlines"."request_id" IS NULL OR "deadlines"."student_id" IS NOT NULL)

exam_publication_time.name: exam_publication_time
exam_publication_time.value: "exam_events"."published_at" IS NULL OR "exam_events"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL

grade_value_scale.name: grade_value_scale
grade_value_scale.value:
("grades"."value" IS NULL AND "grades"."scale" IS NULL) OR
    ("grades"."value" IS NOT NULL AND "grades"."scale" IS NOT NULL AND
      (("grades"."scale" = 'five' AND "grades"."value" BETWEEN 1 AND 5) OR
       ("grades"."scale" = 'hundred' AND "grades"."value" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)))

grade_outcome_required.name: grade_outcome_required
grade_outcome_required.value: "grades"."kind" = 'current' OR "grades"."published_at" IS NULL OR "grades"."outcome" IS NOT NULL

lesson_revision_reason.name: lesson_revision_reason
lesson_revision_reason.value: "lesson_revisions"."status" = 'planned' OR ("lesson_revisions"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("lesson_revisions"."reason") <> '')

notifications_target.name: notifications_target
notifications_target.value:
("notifications"."lesson_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("notifications"."kind" = 'schedule_change')
    AND ("notifications"."deadline_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("notifications"."kind" = 'deadline')
    AND ("notifications"."request_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("notifications"."kind" = 'request_update')
    AND ("notifications"."kind" <> 'request_update' OR "notifications"."student_id" IS NOT NULL)

request_history_reason.name: request_history_reason
request_history_reason.value: "request_history"."to_status" NOT IN ('needs_clarification', 'rejected') OR ("request_history"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("request_history"."reason") <> '')

assignment_result_times.name: assignment_result_times
assignment_result_times.value: ("student_assignment_results"."stage" = 'issued' AND "student_assignment_results"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "student_assignment_results"."defended_at" IS NULL) OR ("student_assignment_results"."stage" = 'completed' AND "student_assignment_results"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "student_assignment_results"."defended_at" IS NULL) OR ("student_assignment_results"."stage" = 'defended' AND "student_assignment_results"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "student_assignment_results"."defended_at" >= "student_assignment_results"."completed_at")
